feedback: Written before this candidate has raced, so no outcome is claimed for it. Evidence: iteration 8 (wheel_track 0.105 m, wheel_radius 0.040 m, kd 0.65) finished 60/60 with slalom at 2.26 s and s-bend steering_oscillation at 0.34. Iteration 9 (sensor_size 0.016 m) lowered s-bend line loss from 0.85 to 0.70 but produced 4 slalom off_track endings (16/20), so the wider footprint is rejected for now. Iteration 2 (wheel_radius 0.035 m, kp 4.0, kd 0.3) overshot, and iterations 3 to 5 showed that raising wheel_radius to 0.040 m with agility steps raised completions. Integration work: I kept the iteration 8 controller unchanged so this wheel step is isolated. The larger wheel adds about 10% ground speed and about 10% turn rate, and I have not yet compensated. Next race: if completion_time falls by 0.1 s or more on slalom and oval, with completions 60/60 and s-bend oscillation at or below about 0.36, try wheel_radius 0.047 m for more speed. If steering_oscillation rises above about 0.36 or any slalom run goes off_track, return wheel_radius to 0.040 m and try wheel_track 0.11 m instead. If line_loss_events stay near 1 per run, sensing rather than speed is the remaining gap, so keep sensor_size 0.012 m and widen the outer sensors.
requested_changes: Keep sensor_size at 0.012 m and body_width 0.08 m, since iteration 9 showed the 0.016 m footprint caused slalom off_track endings (4 of 20).

If completion_time falls by at least 0.1 s with 60/60 completions and s-bend steering_oscillation at or below about 0.36: try wheel_radius 0.047 m, since iteration 8 to this step showed speed rising with radius and no oscillation problem yet.

If steering_oscillation exceeds about 0.36 or any slalom run goes off_track: return wheel_radius to 0.040 m and try wheel_track 0.11 m, since iteration 2 at 0.11 m was stable with kd 0.6 to 0.7 in the later runs.
